# Vendored Entry editor dependencies

These dependencies are pinned copies from their upstream GitHub release tags. Only files actually present in this directory are served locally. Upstream hosts remain fallback sources, and EntryJS itself still loads externally.

| File | Upstream | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| jquery-3.7.1.min.js | https://github.com/jquery/jquery | 3.7.1 | MIT |
| jquery-ui-1.13.3.min.js | https://github.com/jquery/jquery-ui | 1.13.3 | MIT |
| fuzzy-0.1.3.js | https://github.com/mattyork/fuzzy | 0.1.3 | MIT |
| codemirror-5.65.20-*.js | https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5 | 5.65.20 | MIT |

Original license headers are retained in the files. For their complete license texts see the upstream repositories. Do not upgrade an individual dependency without compatibility testing against EntryJS.
